Utilizes the AIDET principle to communicate with others, with a focus on patients and their families. Acknowledge Introduce Explain Duration Thank
Ensures complete, accurate and timely entry of insurance information into legacy system, either at the time of service or during pre-registration/pre-admission.
Verifies insurance benefits on all assigned scheduled admissions and outpatient services, at least 3 days prior to date of service when possible, by using electronic verification systems.
Verifies insurance benefits on all urgent/emergent admits within 24 hours of service (or next business day) by using electronic systems.
Obtains insurance verification, referral, authorization and pre-certification, and documents this information into the legacy system and submits notices of admission, where necessary.
Verifies patient liabilities by using electronic verification systems during pre-registration, where possible.
